777.flavor_en: When it’s in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
777.flavor_es: Cuando se encuentra en peligro, se hace una bola, eriza las púas del lomo y propina descargas eléctricas a diestro y siniestro.

778.name: Mimikyu
778.flavor_en: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
778.flavor_es: Un investigador que miró dentro del saco para estudiar a este Pokémon perdió la vida a causa de una misteriosa enfermedad.

779.name: Bruxish
779.flavor_en: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie’s spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
779.flavor_es: Su piel es tan gruesa que ni las espinas de Mareanie pueden perforarla. Con su fuerte dentadura tritura y engulle dichas espinas.

780.name: Drampa
780.flavor_en: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
780.flavor_es: Es de naturaleza mansa y amable, pero, si se enfurece, puede desatar fuertes vientos capaces de llevarse cualquier cosa por delante.

781.name: Dhelmise
781.flavor_en: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
781.flavor_es: Acecha a su presa hundiendo el ancla en el mar. Es capaz de drenar la vitalidad incluso de presas del tamaño de un Wailord.

782.name: Jangmo-o
782.flavor_en: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.
782.flavor_es: Se comunica con sus congéneres mediante los sonidos que produce al golpear sus escamas, duras como el acero.

783.name: Hakamo-o
783.flavor_en: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
783.flavor_es: Tras hacer sonar sus escamas y proferir su grito de guerra, carga contra el enemigo y lo hace trizas con sus afiladas garras.

784.name: Kommo-o
784.flavor_en: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
784.flavor_es: Se han descubierto antiguas representaciones pictóricas de guerreros que lucían armaduras confeccionadas con escamas de Kommo-o.

785.name: Tapu Koko
785.flavor_en: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
785.flavor_es: El espíritu guardián de Melemele, capaz de blandir el rayo. Su eterna curiosidad le lleva a veces a mostrarse ante las personas.

786.name: Tapu Lele
786.flavor_en: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
786.flavor_es: Este espíritu guardián es tan candoroso como despiadado, por lo que se podría decir que es la encarnación de la naturaleza misma.

787.name: Tapu Bulu
787.flavor_en: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula’ula controls plants.
787.flavor_es: El espíritu guardián de Ula-Ula, que gobierna la flora. Hace repicar su cola para alertar de su presencia y prevenir riñas sin sentido.

788.name: Tapu Fini
788.flavor_en: Although it’s called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
788.flavor_es: A pesar de ser un espíritu guardián, trae desgracias a aquellos que se le acercan sin la debida cortesía.

789.name: Cosmog
789.flavor_en: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
789.flavor_es: Su escasa prudencia y gran curiosidad lo llevan a menudo a ponerse en peligro. En caso de apuro, se teletransporta para huir.

790.name: Cosmoem
790.flavor_en: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
790.flavor_es: Absorbe impetuoso polvo de la atmósfera y pone todo su empeño en crear en su núcleo la energía necesaria para evolucionar.

791.name: Solgaleo
791.flavor_en: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
791.flavor_es: Antiguamente era conocido como la Criatura que se Nutre del Sol. Emite sin cesar una energía luminosa.

792.name: Lunala
792.flavor_en: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
792.flavor_es: Devora toda la luz que haya a su alrededor y adopta la forma de una luna llena que ilumina la oscura noche.

793.name: Nihilego
793.flavor_en: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
793.flavor_es: Llegó a este mundo a través de un Ultraumbral. Es un parásito que se aprovecha de Pokémon y personas.

794.name: Buzzwole
794.flavor_en: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
794.flavor_es: Uno de los Ultraentes. Posee una musculatura excesivamente desarrollada.

795.name: Pheromosa
795.flavor_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
795.flavor_es: Para los seres de este mundo resulta extraño y peligroso, pero en el mundo del que procede es una criatura muy común.

796.name: Xurkitree
796.flavor_en: They’ve been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
796.flavor_es: Uno de los llamados Ultraentes. Algunos ejemplares plantan sus extremidades en el suelo como si fueran árboles y permanecen inmóviles.

797.name: Celesteela
797.flavor_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
797.flavor_es: Para los seres de este mundo resulta extraño y peligroso, pero en el mundo del que procede es una criatura muy común.

798.name: Kartana
798.flavor_en: Although it’s alien to this world and a danger here, it’s apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
798.flavor_es: Para los seres de este mundo resulta extraño y peligroso, pero en el mundo del que procede es una criatura muy común.

799.name: Guzzlord
799.flavor_en: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
799.flavor_es: Uno de los extraños Ultraentes. Siempre está comiendo algo, como poseído de un hambre insaciable.

800.name: Necrozma
800.flavor_en: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
800.flavor_es: Con sus rayos láser destruye todo a su paso en busca de luz para sustentarse.

801.name: Magearna
801.flavor_en: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
801.flavor_es: Pokémon artificial creado por científicos hace unos 500 años. Su verdadera esencia es una pieza llamada Coránima.

802.name: Marshadow
802.flavor_en: This Pokémon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
802.flavor_es: Posee la extraordinaria capacidad de infiltrarse en cualquier sombra, por lo que nadie lo había visto en mucho tiempo.

803.name: Poipole
803.flavor_en: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
803.flavor_es: Un Ultraente originario de otro mundo. Se burla del oponente mientras lo rocía de veneno con el aguijón que tiene en la cabeza.

804.name: Naganadel
804.flavor_en: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
804.flavor_es: Uno de los Ultraentes. Su aguijón segrega un líquido tóxico cuya viscosidad le da una apariencia brillante.

805.name: Stakataka
805.flavor_en: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute’s true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
805.flavor_es: Extraña criatura que podría ser un Ultraente. Parece un muro rocoso hasta que se mueve de repente y ataca.

806.name: Blacephalon
806.flavor_en: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents’ surprise to rob them of their vitality.
806.flavor_es: Un Ultraente surgido de un Ultraumbral. Crea una explosión para sorprender al oponente y aprovecha para absorber su energía vital.

807.name: Zeraora
807.flavor_en: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
807.flavor_es: Las almohadillas de sus patas desprenden descargas eléctricas. Cuando corre, hace que caigan rayos y reverberen los truenos.

808.name: Meltan
808.flavor_en: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
808.flavor_es: Viven en grupos, pero, llegado el momento, el ejemplar más fuerte absorbe a sus camaradas y evoluciona.

809.name: Melmetal
809.flavor_en: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal’s heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokémon.
809.flavor_es: Gracias a la inercia y la fuerza centrífuga, los puñetazos que propina con sus pesadas tuercas son los más potentes del mundo Pokémon.

810.name: Grookey
810.flavor_en: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
810.flavor_es: Ataca golpeando sin cesar con su baqueta, con un entusiasmo que crece a medida que acelera el ritmo.

811.name: Thwackey
811.flavor_en: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.
811.flavor_es: Se concentra tanto en marcar el ritmo que, cuando su rival se debilita en combate, no se da ni cuenta.

812.name: Rillaboom
812.flavor_en: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
812.flavor_es: El percusionista con la técnica más depurada se convierte en líder. Son de carácter tranquilo y dan mucha importancia a la armonía del grupo.

813.name: Scorbunny
813.flavor_en: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
813.flavor_es: Cuando se prepara para combatir, irradia calor por la punta de la nariz y el pelo que le recubre las patas.

814.name: Raboot
814.flavor_en: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
814.flavor_es: Para mejorar su habilidad con los pies, toma bayas de las ramas de los árboles sin usar las manos y juega a darles toques.

815.name: Cinderace
815.flavor_en: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
815.flavor_es: Destaca tanto en ataque como en defensa. Se crece cuando recibe una ovación, pero a veces se luce tanto que termina viéndose en apuros.

816.name: Sobble
816.flavor_en: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
816.flavor_es: Al mojarse, su piel cambia de color y pasa a ser invisible, como si se hubiese camuflado.

817.name: Drizzile
817.flavor_en: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
817.flavor_es: Es inteligente, pero no muestra especial interés por nada. Distribuye trampas por su territorio para mantener alejados a sus enemigos.

818.name: Inteleon
818.flavor_en: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
818.flavor_es: Dispara chorros de agua por la punta de los dedos a 3 mach de velocidad. Con su membrana nictitante puede ver los puntos débiles del rival.

819.name: Skwovet
819.flavor_en: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It’ll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
819.flavor_es: Siempre están comiendo bayas, por lo que son más robustos de lo que aparentan. Frecuentan los huertos en busca de su preciado manjar.

820.name: Greedent
820.flavor_en: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
820.flavor_es: Sus incisivos, de fuerza y dureza extraordinarias, le permiten mordisquear incluso las bayas más duras. Es un Pokémon muy común en Galar.

821.name: Rookidee
821.flavor_en: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
821.flavor_es: Su pequeño cuerpo le permite volar a gran velocidad para golpear los puntos débiles de rivales mucho más grandes que él.

822.name: Corvisquire
822.flavor_en: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.
822.flavor_es: Tras haber librado combates muy duros, ha desarrollado la habilidad de determinar con precisión la fuerza de su adversario.

823.name: Corviknight
823.flavor_en: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.
823.flavor_es: Debido a su excelente capacidad de vuelo y a su gran inteligencia, ejerce de taxi volador en Galar.

824.name: Blipbug
824.flavor_en: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
824.flavor_es: Es habitual verlo en el campo. Los pelos que tiene son sensores con los que percibe lo que ocurre a su alrededor.

825.name: Dottler
825.flavor_en: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
825.flavor_es: Está en constante crecimiento dentro del caparazón. Mientras se prepara para evolucionar, examina el exterior con sus poderes psíquicos.

826.name: Orbeetle
826.flavor_en: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what’s around it—and what’s around it can include things over six miles away.
826.flavor_es: Se sirve de sus poderes psíquicos, con los que es capaz de percibir lo que ocurre en un radio de 10 km, para examinar sus alrededores.

827.name: Nickit
827.flavor_en: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
827.flavor_es: Prudente y astuto, borra con la cola las huellas que deja al huir tras robarle el alimento a otro Pokémon.

828.name: Thievul
828.flavor_en: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
828.flavor_es: Un Pokémon ágil y de afiladas garras que se alimenta de huevos y comida robados. Los Boltund son su enemigo natural.

829.name: Gossifleur
829.flavor_en: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
829.flavor_es: Muchos los crían tras quedar prendados de lo adorables que resultan cuando cantan dando vueltas empujados por la brisa.

830.name: Eldegoss
830.flavor_en: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
830.flavor_es: El hilo fabricado a partir de su algodón es muy bello y brillante; uno de los productos estrella de la región de Galar.

831.name: Wooloo
831.flavor_en: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won’t be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
831.flavor_es: Si le crece el pelo demasiado, no puede moverse. Las telas confeccionadas con lana de Wooloo son sorprendentemente resistentes.

832.name: Dubwool
832.flavor_en: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
832.flavor_es: Sus espléndidos cuernos sirven de reclamo para atraer al sexo opuesto. No los utiliza como arma.

833.name: Chewtle
833.flavor_en: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
833.flavor_es: El cuerno que tiene en la cabeza es duro como una roca. Lo usa para atacar al rival y, cuando este baja la guardia, lo muerde y no lo suelta.

834.name: Drednaw
834.flavor_en: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
834.flavor_es: Su cuello extensible le permite alcanzar a los rivales a distancia. Hundiendo sus afilados dientes, les da el golpe de gracia.

835.name: Yamper
835.flavor_en: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
835.flavor_es: Son muy glotones, por lo que ayudan a la gente a cambio de comida. Echan chispas al correr.

836.name: Boltund
836.flavor_en: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
836.flavor_es: La electricidad le confiere una enorme fuerza en las patas. Su velocidad punta puede superar los 90 km/h sin problema.

837.name: Rolycoly
837.flavor_en: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
837.flavor_es: Recorre incluso los caminos más impracticables y pedregosos como si de un monociclo se tratase. La combustión de carbón es su fuente vital.

838.name: Carkol
838.flavor_en: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
838.flavor_es: Gira las patas a gran velocidad para correr a unos 30 km/h. Emite llamas a una temperatura de 1000 °C.

839.name: Coalossal
839.flavor_en: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
839.flavor_es: Cuando se enzarza en un combate, la montaña de carbón arde al rojo vivo y esparce chispas que calcinan todo lo que le rodea.

840.name: Applin
840.flavor_en: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
840.flavor_es: Nada más nacer se refugia en una manzana, cuyo interior va devorando a medida que crece. El sabor de la fruta determina la evolución.

841.name: Flapple
841.flavor_en: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
841.flavor_es: Escupe una saliva sumamente ácida y vuela con sus alas compuestas por piel de manzana, cuyo aspecto es capaz de adoptar.

842.name: Appletun
842.flavor_en: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
842.flavor_es: Su cuerpo está recubierto de néctar. La piel de la espalda es tan dulce que los niños de antaño solían tomarla como merienda.

843.name: Silicobra
843.flavor_en: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
843.flavor_es: Expulsa arena por los orificios nasales. Una vez que aturde al enemigo, aprovecha la ocasión para ocultarse bajo tierra.

844.name: Sandaconda
844.flavor_en: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
844.flavor_es: La manera tan particular que tiene de enrollarse sobre sí mismo le permite expulsar con mayor eficacia la arena que almacena en la bolsa.

845.name: Cramorant
845.flavor_en: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
845.flavor_es: Traga Arrokuda enteros debido a su glotonería, tan notable que en ocasiones ingiere hasta otros Pokémon sin querer.

846.name: Arrokuda
846.flavor_en: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
846.flavor_es: Cuando tiene el estómago lleno, le cuesta moverse y corre el riesgo de ser engullido por algún Cramorant.

847.name: Barraskewda
847.flavor_en: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
847.flavor_es: Hace girar su aleta caudal para impulsarse y arremeter contra la presa, a la que ensarta a una velocidad que supera los 100 nudos.

848.name: Toxel
848.flavor_en: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
848.flavor_es: Provoca una reacción química para generar energía eléctrica con sus toxinas. Aunque de bajo voltaje, puede causar entumecimiento.

849.name: Toxtricity
849.flavor_en: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
849.flavor_es: Posee un carácter belicoso e irascible. Bebe una gran cantidad de agua estancada para absorber sus toxinas.

850.name: Sizzlipede
850.flavor_en: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
850.flavor_es: Oprime a sus presas con su cuerpo candente. Una vez bien tostadas, las devora con fruición.

851.name: Centiskorch
851.flavor_en: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
851.flavor_es: Posee una naturaleza agresiva. El peligro que entraña su cuerpo candente es considerable, aunque sus afilados colmillos no le van a la zaga.

852.name: Clobbopus
852.flavor_en: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
852.flavor_es: Su inteligencia es similar a la de un niño de tres años. Sus tentáculos se desprenden a menudo, pero ni se inmuta, ya que se regeneran solos.

853.name: Grapploct
853.flavor_en: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
853.flavor_es: Se aventura en tierra firme para buscar rivales contra los que luchar para medir su valía. Tras terminar el combate, regresa al mar.

854.name: Sinistea
854.flavor_en: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
854.flavor_es: La taza de té donde se hospeda forma parte de una antigua y valiosa vajilla, de la que circulan numerosas falsificaciones.

855.name: Polteageist
855.flavor_en: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
855.flavor_es: Si avista una taza de té abandonada a su suerte, la rellena vertiendo parte de su propio cuerpo para generar otro Polteageist.

856.name: Hatenna
856.flavor_en: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
856.flavor_es: Siente predilección por los lugares despoblados. Si percibe una emoción intensa, emprende la huida a toda prisa.

857.name: Hattrem
857.flavor_en: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
857.flavor_es: Silencia al objetivo atizándole con los mechones. Despliega una potencia devastadora capaz de noquear a un boxeador profesional.

858.name: Hatterene
858.flavor_en: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
858.flavor_es: Recibe el apodo de Hechicera del Bosque. Quienes arman demasiado barullo se exponen a ser despedazados por las garras de su tentáculo.

859.name: Impidimp
859.flavor_en: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
859.flavor_es: Se infiltra en las casas para hurtar a sus anchas y, por si fuera poco, nutrirse de la energía negativa que liberan sus contrariados habitantes.

860.name: Morgrem
860.flavor_en: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
860.flavor_es: De noche, atrae con astucia a su objetivo hasta el bosque. Al parecer, tiene la capacidad de hacer crecer productos agrícolas.

861.name: Grimmsnarl
861.flavor_en: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
861.flavor_es: Su cabello desempeña una función similar a la de fibras musculares. Al soltárselo, su movimiento tentacular le permite reducir a su objetivo.

862.name: Obstagoon
862.flavor_en: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
862.flavor_es: Evoluciona tras haber librado numerosas peleas. El grito de guerra que profiere mientras pone los brazos en cruz atemoriza a cualquier rival.

863.name: Perrserker
863.flavor_en: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
863.flavor_es: Su devoción por la lucha ha propiciado que evolucionara y le ha conferido unas peligrosas garras que se convierten en dagas al extenderse.

864.name: Cursola
864.flavor_en: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
864.flavor_es: Conviene tener cuidado con el cuerpo espectral que recubre su alma, pues quien lo toque podría acabar inerte como una piedra.

865.name: Sirfetch’d
865.flavor_en: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
865.flavor_es: Repele ataques con las hojas de su duro puerro y contraataca con su tallo afilado. El puerro que le sirve de armamento sigue siendo comestible.

866.name: Mr. Rime
866.flavor_en: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
866.flavor_es: Se ha granjeado la simpatía de todo el mundo por sus cómicos movimientos. Emite poderes psíquicos por el motivo de su barriga.

867.name: Runerigus
867.flavor_en: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
867.flavor_es: Su cuerpo, similar a una sombra, no debe tocarse bajo ningún concepto o se visualizarán los horribles recuerdos impregnados en la imagen.

868.name: Milcery
868.flavor_en: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
868.flavor_es: Se dice que las pastelerías donde ha aparecido Milcery tienen casi todas las papeletas para saborear las mieles del éxito.

869.name: Alcremie
869.flavor_en: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
869.flavor_es: La nata que le brota de las manos es más dulce y sustanciosa cuando está feliz.

870.name: Falinks
870.flavor_en: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
870.flavor_es: Este Pokémon está formado por seis individuos que cambian de formación al luchar, haciendo gala de un notable espíritu de equipo.

871.name: Pincurchin
871.flavor_en: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
871.flavor_es: Acumula electricidad en cada una de sus púas. Aunque estas se rompan, son capaces de seguir descargando energía durante 3 h.

872.name: Snom
872.flavor_en: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
872.flavor_es: Se nutre de la nieve acumulada en el terreno. Cuanta más ingiere, más imponentes se vuelven las púas que presenta en el lomo.

873.name: Frosmoth
873.flavor_en: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
873.flavor_es: No muestra la menor compasión con quien asole el campo: lo escarmienta batiendo sus gélidas alas para provocar una ventisca.

874.name: Stonjourner
874.flavor_en: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
874.flavor_es: Una vez al año y en una fecha concreta, tienen la costumbre de aparecer de la nada para reunirse y formar un círculo.

875.name: Eiscue
875.flavor_en: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
875.flavor_es: Se enfría constantemente la cara con hielo por su escasa resistencia al calor. Utiliza el pelo de la cabeza para pescar en el mar.

876.name: Indeedee
876.flavor_en: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
876.flavor_es: Con sus cuernos percibe las emociones de los seres vivos que se hallen cerca. Los sentimientos positivos constituyen su fuente de energía.

877.name: Morpeko
877.flavor_en: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
877.flavor_es: Siempre tiene apetito, sin importar lo mucho que coma. Lleva con sumo cuidado las semillas que ha tostado con su propia electricidad.

878.name: Cufant
878.flavor_en: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
878.flavor_es: Realiza tareas que requieren de esfuerzo físico, es su fuerte. Con la lluvia, su cuerpo de cobre se oxida y adquiere una tonalidad verde intensa.

879.name: Copperajah
879.flavor_en: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
879.flavor_es: Viven en manadas. La fuerza prensil de su trompa es tan extraordinaria que le permite hacer añicos incluso grandes rocas.

880.name: Dracozolt
880.flavor_en: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
880.flavor_es: Produce electricidad con la robusta musculatura de la cola. El tamaño de la parte superior del cuerpo palidece en comparación con la inferior.

881.name: Arctozolt
881.flavor_en: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
881.flavor_es: Antiguamente vivía en el mar y usaba el hielo del cuerpo para conservar los alimentos. Su extrema lentitud, sin embargo, lo condenó a la extinción.

882.name: Dracovish
882.flavor_en: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
882.flavor_es: Exhibe con orgullo su inmensa capacidad motriz, que le permite superar los 60 km/h, pero solo puede respirar bajo el agua.

883.name: Arctovish
883.flavor_en: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
883.flavor_es: Aunque la piel de su rostro era capaz de resistir cualquier ataque, su dificultad para respirar acabó provocando su extinción.

884.name: Duraludon
884.flavor_en: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
884.flavor_es: Hace gala de una agilidad extraordinaria, ya que su cuerpo está compuesto de un metal especial. Detesta la lluvia, por lo que habita en cuevas.

885.name: Dreepy
885.flavor_en: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
885.flavor_es: En solitario es tan débil que no sería rival ni para un niño, pero, al entrenarse con sus congéneres, evoluciona y se vuelve más fuerte.

886.name: Drakloak
886.flavor_en: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
886.flavor_es: Si no lleva un Dreepy del que cuidar encima de la cabeza, se intranquiliza y trata de sustituirlo con otro Pokémon.

887.name: Dragapult
887.flavor_en: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
887.flavor_es: Al parecer, los Dreepy que residen en sus cuernos esperan con ilusión el momento de ser propulsados a velocidad supersónica.

888.name: Zacian
888.flavor_en: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
888.flavor_es: Hay quien lo considera una suerte de figura fraterna a la par que rival de Zamazenta, un Pokémon sumido en un profundo letargo.

889.name: Zamazenta
889.flavor_en: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
889.flavor_es: Con la apariencia de una estatua de piedra, este Pokémon se sumió en un letargo tan profundo que acabó cayendo en el olvido.

890.name: Eternatus
890.flavor_en: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
890.flavor_es: Fue hallado en el interior de un meteorito caído hace 20 000 años. Por lo visto, está relacionado con el misterio que rodea al fenómeno Dinamax.

891.name: Kubfu
891.flavor_en: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
891.flavor_es: Al tirar de los mechones blancos de la cabeza, acrecienta su espíritu luchador y empieza a acumular fuerza en el órgano de su bajo vientre.

892.name: Urshifu
892.flavor_en: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
892.flavor_es: Vive en zonas montañosas en áreas recónditas, donde entrena corriendo por escarpados riscos para fortalecer sus piernas y refinar su técnica.

893.name: Zarude
893.flavor_en: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
893.flavor_es: Las lianas que le brotan del cuerpo nutren y fertilizan el mantillo del bosque cuando se le desprenden.

894.name: Regieleki
894.flavor_en: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
894.flavor_es: Todo su cuerpo es un órgano electrógeno, cuya potencia sería suficiente para abastecer la región de Galar por completo.

895.name: Regidrago
895.flavor_en: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
895.flavor_es: Todo su cuerpo es una gema de energía dragón cristalizada. Se cree que posee los poderes de todos los Pokémon dragón.

896.name: Glastrier
896.flavor_en: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
896.flavor_es: Cuenta con una fuerza física sobrecogedora. La máscara de hielo que le cubre el rostro es cien veces más dura que el diamante.

897.name: Spectrier
897.flavor_en: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
897.flavor_es: Amante de la quietud y la soledad, galopa por las tinieblas nocturnas absorbiendo la energía vital de toda criatura que esté durmiendo.

898.name: Calyrex
898.flavor_en: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
898.flavor_es: Legendario monarca del antiguo Galar. Posee el poder de sanar el espíritu y de hacer brotar la vegetación.

899.name: Wyrdeer
899.flavor_en: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

900.name: Kleavor
900.flavor_en: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

901.name: Ursaluna
901.flavor_en: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

902.name: Basculegion
902.flavor_en: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

903.name: Sneasler
903.flavor_en: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

904.name: Overqwil
904.flavor_en: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

905.name: Enamorus
905.flavor_en: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

906.name: Sprigatito
906.flavor_en: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

907.name: Floragato
907.flavor_en: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

908.name: Meowscarada
908.flavor_en: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

909.name: Fuecoco
909.flavor_en: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

910.name: Crocalor
910.flavor_en: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

911.name: Skeledirge
911.flavor_en: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

912.name: Quaxly
912.flavor_en: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

913.name: Quaxwell
913.flavor_en: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

914.name: Quaquaval
914.flavor_en: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

915.name: Lechonk
915.flavor_en: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

916.name: Oinkologne
916.flavor_en: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

917.name: Tarountula
917.flavor_en: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

918.name: Spidops
918.flavor_en: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

919.name: Nymble
919.flavor_en: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

920.name: Lokix
920.flavor_en: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

921.name: Pawmi
921.flavor_en: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

922.name: Pawmo
922.flavor_en: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

923.name: Pawmot
923.flavor_en: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

924.name: Tandemaus
924.flavor_en: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

925.name: Maushold
925.flavor_en: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

926.name: Fidough
926.flavor_en: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

927.name: Dachsbun
927.flavor_en: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

928.name: Smoliv
928.flavor_en: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

929.name: Dolliv
929.flavor_en: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

930.name: Arboliva
930.flavor_en: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

931.name: Squawkabilly
931.flavor_en: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

932.name: Nacli
932.flavor_en: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

933.name: Naclstack
933.flavor_en: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

934.name: Garganacl
934.flavor_en: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

935.name: Charcadet
935.flavor_en: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

936.name: Armarouge
936.flavor_en: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

937.name: Ceruledge
937.flavor_en: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

938.name: Tadbulb
938.flavor_en: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

939.name: Bellibolt
939.flavor_en: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

940.name: Wattrel
940.flavor_en: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

941.name: Kilowattrel
941.flavor_en: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

942.name: Maschiff
942.flavor_en: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

943.name: Mabosstiff
943.flavor_en: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

944.name: Shroodle
944.flavor_en: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

945.name: Grafaiai
945.flavor_en: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

946.name: Bramblin
946.flavor_en: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

947.name: Brambleghast
947.flavor_en: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

948.name: Toedscool
948.flavor_en: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

949.name: Toedscruel
949.flavor_en: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

950.name: Klawf
950.flavor_en: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

951.name: Capsakid
951.flavor_en: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

952.name: Scovillain
952.flavor_en: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

953.name: Rellor
953.flavor_en: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

954.name: Rabsca
954.flavor_en: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

955.name: Flittle
955.flavor_en: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

956.name: Espathra
956.flavor_en: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

957.name: Tinkatink
957.flavor_en: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

958.name: Tinkatuff
958.flavor_en: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

959.name: Tinkaton
959.flavor_en: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

960.name: Wiglett
960.flavor_en: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

961.name: Wugtrio
961.flavor_en: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

962.name: Bombirdier
962.flavor_en: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

963.name: Finizen
963.flavor_en: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

964.name: Palafin
964.flavor_en: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

965.name: Varoom
965.flavor_en: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

966.name: Revavroom
966.flavor_en: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

967.name: Cyclizar
967.flavor_en: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

968.name: Orthworm
968.flavor_en: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

969.name: Glimmet
969.flavor_en: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

970.name: Glimmora
970.flavor_en: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

971.name: Greavard
971.flavor_en: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

972.name: Houndstone
972.flavor_en: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

973.name: Flamigo
973.flavor_en: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

974.name: Cetoddle
974.flavor_en: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

975.name: Cetitan
975.flavor_en: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

976.name: Veluza
976.flavor_en: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

977.name: Dondozo
977.flavor_en: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

978.name: Tatsugiri
978.flavor_en: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

979.name: Annihilape
979.flavor_en: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

980.name: Clodsire
980.flavor_en: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

981.name: Farigiraf
981.flavor_en: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

982.name: Dudunsparce
982.flavor_en: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

983.name: Kingambit
983.flavor_en: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

984.name: Great Tusk
984.flavor_en: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

985.name: Scream Tail
985.flavor_en: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

986.name: Brute Bonnet
986.flavor_en: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

987.name: Flutter Mane
987.flavor_en: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

988.name: Slither Wing
988.flavor_en: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

989.name: Sandy Shocks
989.flavor_en: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

990.name: Iron Treads
990.flavor_en: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

991.name: Iron Bundle
991.flavor_en: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

992.name: Iron Hands
992.flavor_en: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

993.name: Iron Jugulis
993.flavor_en: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

994.name: Iron Moth
994.flavor_en: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

995.name: Iron Thorns
995.flavor_en: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

996.name: Frigibax
996.flavor_en: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

997.name: Arctibax
997.flavor_en: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

998.name: Baxcalibur
998.flavor_en: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

999.name: Gimmighoul
999.flavor_en: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

1000.name: Gholdengo
1000.flavor_en: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

1001.name: Wo-Chien
1001.flavor_en: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

1002.name: Chien-Pao
1002.flavor_en: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

1003.name: Ting-Lu
1003.flavor_en: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

1004.name: Chi-Yu
1004.flavor_en: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

1005.name: Roaring Moon
1005.flavor_en: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

1006.name: Iron Valiant
1006.flavor_en: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

1007.name: Koraidon
1007.flavor_en: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

1008.name: Miraidon
1008.flavor_en: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

1009.name: Walking Wake
1009.flavor_en: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

1010.name: Iron Leaves
1010.flavor_en: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

1011.name: Dipplin
1011.flavor_en: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

1012.name: Poltchageist
1012.flavor_en: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

1013.name: Sinistcha
1013.flavor_en: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

1014.name: Okidogi
1014.flavor_en: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

1015.name: Munkidori
1015.flavor_en: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

1016.name: Fezandipiti
1016.flavor_en: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

1017.name: Ogerpon
1017.flavor_en: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

1018.name: Archaludon
1018.flavor_en: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

1019.name: Hydrapple
1019.flavor_en: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

1020.name: Gouging Fire
1020.flavor_en: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

1021.name: Raging Bolt
1021.flavor_en: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

1022.name: Iron Boulder
1022.flavor_en: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

1023.name: Iron Crown
1023.flavor_en: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

1024.name: Terapagos
1024.flavor_en: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

1025.name: Pecharunt
1025.flavor_en: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
